options.text: Residents without transport or with mobility limits
People with private cars and flexible schedules
Hotel guests near the airport

questions.explanation: People without transport or with mobility limits cannot evacuate in time. Car owners and flexible workers are the most mobile, not the least.

questions.topic: Explaining the risk equation

stimulus.body: Source note: Explaining the risk equation. The three factors multiply because if any one is zero, risk is zero, and small changes in any factor scale the whole risk. Adding would let one large factor dominate regardless of…

questions.stem: Using the source note, explain why risk factors multiply.

answer.exemplar: The three factors multiply because if any one is zero, risk is zero, and small changes in any factor scale the whole risk. Adding would let one large factor dominate regardless of the others.

questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: What a mutual-aid agreement commits
questions.learningObjective: Identify the scope of mutual aid

stimulus.body: Source note: Personnel, equipment and resources across jurisdictions. This is the claim the evidence in the topic supports.

questions.stem: A source note on what a mutual-aid agreement commits reads: "Personnel, equipment and resources across jurisdictions" Using that evidence, what mutual-aid agreements typically cover.

options.text: Only financial loans between governments
options.misconception: it covers only a slice of what the item asks about

options.text: Personnel, equipment and resources across jurisdictions
Permanent transfer of territory
Replacement of local government

questions.explanation: Mutual aid covers personnel, equipment and resources. It is not limited to loans, territory or government replacement. Easy to pick on a quick read, "Only financial loans between governments" fails on closer inspection: it covers only a slice of what the item asks about. Superficially appealing, "Permanent transfer of territory" is a common wrong turn: it confuses aid with annexation. Although plausible, "Replacement of local government" is a tempting but wrong choice: it confuses aid with takeover.
questions.hint: Think shared emergency resources.

options.text: Raise vulnerability to lower costs
